posts.text: The XRP Ledger Foundation and VS1 Finance have open-sourced a lending reference app combining five ledger amendments - Credentials, Permissioned Domains, Single Asset Vault, Lending Protocol and Batch - on Devnet. Fixed-term loans run without on-chain collateral, with off-chain credit checks and first-loss capital. Vault and lending votes reached 22 and 23 of 35 validators, short of the 29 needed. https:// crypto.news/xrpl-lending-refer ence-app/ # UPD8 # DAO # News # DeFi
